# <span id="aanchor108"></span> Auto Edits Editor

The Auto Edits Editor allows you to specify automatic edits that can be applied to applicable data on one or more meters. This is especially useful if you have data imported or entered every month for which you know you have to change specific detail(s), characteristic(s), or analysis.

Auto edits apply to all applicable data, regardless of the status of the record; that is, if the data is closed, an auto edit still applies if the data meets the condition of the auto edit and a PPA is also created. Auto edits do not apply to meter data that is created or edited from the Auto Estimate service or Master Allocations.

<div class="procedure">

To set up an auto edit:

Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Auto Edits Editor**.

When Auto Edit criteria are defined on more than one tab, the Auto Edits are applied in the following order:

- Auto edits defined on tabs that do not trigger a recalculation
- Auto edits defined on tabs that trigger a recalculation of the correlation factors applicable to that meter; correlation factors are then recalculated
- Auto edits defined on tabs that trigger a recalculation of volume and mass; volume and mass are then recalculated



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 605;height: 337;" />

</div>

## Gas Auto Edits

Upon import of meter data, FLOWCAL attempts to apply the Auto Edit to each periodic record that is imported. On edits, FLOWCAL attempts to apply the Auto Edit to each periodic record that is within the Contract Month of the data that is modified.

For meter characteristic Auto Edits, the Auto Edit only applies to characteristic records within the Contract Month. Additionally, Auto Edits are not applied to time frames where no periodic records exist. Meter Characteristic records are split by the Auto Edit process as needed.

Requires the FLOWCAL Gas module.

## Liquid Auto Edits

On import of meter data, FLOWCAL attempts to apply the Auto Edit to each periodic record that is imported. On edits, FLOWCAL attempts to apply the Auto Edit to each periodic record that is specifically modified by the user.

For meter characteristic Auto Edits, the Auto Edit only applies to characteristic records within the Contract Month that are tied to a periodic record that is imported or specifically modified by the user. Additionally, Auto Edits are not applied to time frames where no periodic records exist. Meter Characteristic records are split by the Auto Edit process as needed and an exception will be generated to alert the user. If the Product is changed from an Auto Edit, then the batch is split at the effective date of the characteristic record affected before calculations take place.

If the FLOWCAL Option ‘Reconcile Volume’ is enabled, the Auto Edit Editor menu item is disabled and any Auto Edit that attempts to be processed is skipped.

For liquid meter periodic data, the user has the ability to set a data point to a numerical value or to choose from a list of data points to copy the value from. For example, if Gross Standard Volume (GSV) \> 0, then set Meter Temperature = Observed Temperature. To set a data point to a numerical value, choose the Action ‘New Value’ so that a numerical value can be provided.

Requires the FLOWCAL Liquids module.

## Auto Edit Editor Tabs

The tab that the Auto Edit criteria are defined on determines the type of recalculation that occurs after the Auto Edit is applied. If an Auto Edit is defined on the ‘Vol. and Mass’ (Liquids) or ‘Volume’ (Gas) tab, then that Auto Edit triggers FLOWCAL to perform a recalculation of Volume and Mass. If an Auto Edit is defined on the ‘CF’ (Liquids) or ‘VCF’ (Gas) tab. then that Auto Edit triggers FLOWCAL to perform a recalculation of all Correlation Factors applicable to that meter. If an auto edit is defined on the ‘Operations’, ‘Other’, or ‘Customer and Other Fields’ tab, then no recalculation occurs.

#### Action Operators

<table class="TableStyle-FCtable" style="mc-table-style: url(&#39;../../Resources/TableStyles/FCtable.css&#39;);width: 700px;" data-cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr class="TableStyle-FCtable-Body-Standard1">
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyE-Column-Standard1" style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; vertical-align: top; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 1px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">=</span></td>
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyD-Column-Standard1">Configure an Auto Edit to set the current value exactly equal to a constant.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="TableStyle-FCtable-Body-Standard2">
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyE-Column-Standard2" style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; vertical-align: top; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 1px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0;">+/-</td>
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyD-Column-Standard2"><p>Configure an Auto Edit to add or subtract a constant from the current value.</p>
<p>To add, a positive constant must be provided. To subtract, a negative constant must be provided. If the data point configured to be added or subtracted by a constant is not provided on import, then FLOWCAL assumes 0 for the data point.</p>
<p>For example: If an Auto Edit is configured to set Volume = Volume + 1000, but Volume is not provided on import, then Volume is set to 1000 = 0+1000.</p>
<p>Certain values that would not logically go below zero such as differential pressure and pressure will only be set to 0 if subtracting the specified amount will take it below zero. For instance: If an auto edit is to subtract 10 from the pressure, but the pressure is 9, the pressure will be set to 0.</p>
<p>This operator will only be applied to imported data.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="TableStyle-FCtable-Body-Standard1">
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyE-Column-Standard1" style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; vertical-align: top; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 1px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0;">*</td>
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyD-Column-Standard1"><p>Configure an Auto Edit to multiply the current value by a constant. If the data point configured to be multiplied by a constant is not provided on import, then FLOWCAL assumes 1 for the data point. For example, if an Auto Edit is configured to set Volume = Volume * 1000, but Volume is not provided on import, then Volume is set to 1000 = 1*1000.</p>
<p>This operator will only be applied to imported data.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="TableStyle-FCtable-Body-Standard2">
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyE-Column-Standard2" style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; vertical-align: top; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 1px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0;">/</td>
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyD-Column-Standard2">Configure an Auto Edit to divide the current value by a constant. If the data point configured to be divided by a constant is not provided on import, then the division will not occur. This operator will only be applied to imported data.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="TableStyle-FCtable-Body-Standard1">
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyB-Column-Standard1" style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; vertical-align: top; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 1px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0;">/VCF</td>
<td class="TableStyle-FCtable-BodyA-Column-Standard1">Configure an Auto Edit to divide the Volume by the Correlation Factor (/VCF) in order to set the data to what FLOWCAL calculates for the Volume. Only available if the specified value is Volume.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>

- CF = 1

  This option is only available from the left Action drop down on the Vol. and Mass sub tab. When selected, if the conditional criteria for this row are met, all CF values for a given record are set to 1.

- New Value

  This option is only available from the right Action drop down. When this option is selected, the text box to the right of the drop down will become enabled so that the user may input a numerical value.

#### Action Operators

|  |  |
|:--:|----|
| <span style="font-weight: bold;">=</span> | Configure an Auto Edit to set the current value exactly equal to a constant or data point. |
| +/- | Configure an Auto Edit to add or subtract a constant or data point from the current value. This operator will only be applied to imported data. |
| \* | Configure an Auto Edit to multiply the current value by a constant or data point. This operator will only be applied to imported data. |
| / | Configure an Auto Edit to divide the current value by a constant or data point. This operator will only be applied to imported data. |

For Action Operators other than "=", if a data point that is configured to be manipulated by an Auto Edit is not available on import, then the Auto Edit is not applied. For example: If an Auto Edit is configured to set Mass = Mass \* 1000 but Mass is not provided on import, then the Auto Edit is not applied.
